cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, recites all the words of a song in the hearing of the people, a song about the LORD, the Rock (Deuteronomy 32:4). And he isn't alone. Beside him is the man the LORD commissioned to bring the Israelites into the land (Deuteronomy 31:23).

cards.question: Moses comes to recite the song with the man the LORD commissioned to bring the Israelites into the land. Who is it?

cards.text: Moses finishes every last word of the song to all Israel. And just when you think he's done, he's got ONE MORE THING to say, like me at the oven door yelling "one more batch" at midnight.
He tells them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day…" And he tells them what those words are for.

cards.question: Moses tells all Israel to take his words to heart. Why does he say they should?

answers.text: So they can command their children to follow the law
So they can teach the law to the nations nearby
So they can carve the law on the city gates

cards.text: Moses tells them these are "not idle words" for Israel. In other words, this is NOT one of those warranty cards in my old junk drawer that nobody ever read.

cards.question: Moses says these words aren't idle for Israel. What reason does he give?
True or false: Moses says that by these words, Israel will live long in the land across the Jordan.

cards.text: On that SAME DAY, the LORD speaks to Moses. This man just recited a whole song to all Israel, and I need a lie-down after stamping one tray.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses to go up into the Abarim Range to Mount ___.

cards.text: Mount Nebo, in the land of Moab, right across from Jericho. Friend, if the LORD told ME to climb a mountain, I'd be at the bottom on my gold base, hopping and yelling "ALMOST THERE" for a month.

cards.question: Up on Mount Nebo, the LORD tells Moses to ___ the land of Canaan, which He is giving to the Israelites.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells Moses what will happen to him there on the mountain.

cards.question: Then the LORD tells Moses what will happen to him there on Mount Nebo. What is it?

answers.text: He will die and be gathered to his people
He will be taken up into heaven alive
He will stay there and pray for Israel

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses he'll die on the mountain just like someone in his family did. Who?

cards.text: Moses will die there, just like his brother Aaron died on Mount Hor, and I think this one hurts. Then the LORD tells Moses why, and it goes back to the waters of Meribah-kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD says only Aaron broke faith with Him at Meribah-kadesh.

cards.text: Both of them broke faith with Him, the LORD says, by failing to treat Him as holy in front of the Israelites. So what does that mean for Moses and the land?

cards.question: True or false: The LORD tells Moses he will get to enter the land He is giving the Israelites.

cards.text: Moses will see the land from a distance, but he won't enter it. That's where we'll leave him for now, friend, because his story's not over yet.
